text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today is the Spring Fan Appreciation 
Festival! A massive event akin to a school 
festival, where the academy opens its 
gates to the fans.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Various Umamusume put on shows and 
festivities separate from racing, drawing 
in a massive crowd of fans—

text_block_list.name: Student Council Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
“—Attendance is far higher than expected, 
and guiding the flow near the gates is 
becoming difficult...!”

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Send Teams C and D from the patrol squad 
to the front gate.

text_block_list.name: Student Council Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
A consultation was brought to us about a 
fan taking flash photography without 
permission...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Contact the nearby patrol team and have 
them bring a security guard along when 
issuing the warning.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The student council members in charge of 
running the Fan Appreciation Festival were 
dizzyingly busy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was also helping Air Groove on the event 
operations side this time, but...

text_block_list.name: Student Council Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Vice President, we have a problem!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: What is the matter?

text_block_list.name: Student Council Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
The girl scheduled to participate in the 
scavenger hunt after this suddenly came 
down with a fever, leaving an open 
spot...!

text_block_list.name: Student Council Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
It seems there was a mix-up and the 
message was delayed... At this rate, 
finding replacement participants will 
be...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Conveniently, the President will be 
returning shortly. Once we switch out, I 
shall participate in the scavenger hunt.

text_block_list.name: Student Council Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Huh? R-Really!?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Unlike a marathon, this event won't take 
long. I will return as soon as it is over.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Come along with me as well. I'll have 
communications from the student council 
routed through you.

text_block_list.name: Male Fan A
text_block_list.text: Wait, seriously?! Isn't that Air Groove?!

text_block_list.name: Female Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"No way! You're entering the scavenger 
hunt!?"

text_block_list.name: Announcement
text_block_list.text:
...An announcement for all spectators. 
There has been a change of participants 
for the scavenger hunt race.

text_block_list.name: Announcement
text_block_list.text:
Due to a sudden illness, Air Groove will 
be substituting in the number 5 slot. We 
ask for the spectators' understanding.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Oooooooohhh!!!)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Now then— Since I'm participating, I must 
give it my all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (CLANK!!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentator Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
And now, the scavenger hunt has just 
begun! Dear fans, when the Umamusume come 
to the stands, please lend them your 
support!

text_block_list.name: Commentator Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"The spotlight contender, Air Groove, is 
fast, so fast! She's the first to reach 
the table with the prompt cards!"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: (Alright. The prompt is—)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Gah!? What did you say...?!

text_block_list.name: Commentator Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove is looking completely baffled! 
However, she is heading toward the 
spectator stands at incredible speed!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Among those watching in the audience, is 
there anyone who happens to have my 
merchandise!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In Air Groove's hand was a slip of paper 
that read, "Own Merch ×3."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"This prompt puts Air Groove at a 
disadvantage, since fans weren't informed 
of her participation beforehand...!"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
If anyone has one, please, lend it to 
me...!

text_block_list.name: Female Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes, yes, yes! I have one! I've got an 
acrylic keychain!

text_block_list.name: Female Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Me too!! I have Air Groove-chan's Empress 
wristband!

text_block_list.name: Male Fan A
text_block_list.text: U-Um, I want... a tin badge too...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
—Thank you very much. I, the "Empress", 
shall surely live up to all of your 
cheering.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove received the item from the fan 
and sprinted toward the goal line.

text_block_list.name: Female Fan B
text_block_list.text:
*Gasp*—so cool I forgot to breathe. I'm so 
glad I was born in the same dimension...

text_block_list.name: Female Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Our eyes, our eyes, our eyes met, waah, 
and his fingers were so 
sleeeennndeeer............

text_block_list.name: Male Fan A
text_block_list.text:
...I'm gonna make that can badge a family 
heirloom.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just like that, Air Groove brilliantly 
crossed the finish line of the scavenger 
hunt in 1st place—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, the Fan Appreciation Festival 
came to a safe close without any major 
issues...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"As for Air Groove, who was busy both 
running the event and competing as an 
athlete—"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I have to admit, I'm a little tired.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your help. It was quite a 
hand.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: At any rate... I'm glad it ended safely.
choice_data_list: That scavenger hunt was tough too, huh.

That scavenger hunt was tough too, wasn't 
it?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I was an alternate entry, but once I 
was in, I went out there intending to win.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Though this time, the fans really saved 
me...
choice_data_list: I have to deliver at the Takarazuka Kinen.

I have to deliver at the Takarazuka Kinen, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Air Groove and I toasted with 
carrot juice to celebrate the Fan 
Appreciation Festival ending without a 
hitch.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I secretly prayed that today's interaction 
with the fans would become a source of 
strength for her in the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Female Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I do, I do, I totally do! I'm a hardcore 
fan, so I've got everything from bromides 
to acrylic keychains, pin badges, and 
phone cases——!!

text_block_list.name: Female Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Over here, we have image accessories!! A 
complete Air Groove-themed coordinate!!

text_block_list.name: Female Fan D
text_block_list.text:
I've got a fan right here~~!! Look over 
here~~! Air Groove-cha~n!

text_block_list.name: Male Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Empress shirt! Empress towel! Empress 
wristband! Empress penlight! I've 
literally got the full set of Empress 
merch, you know?!

text_block_list.name: Lots of Fans
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove! Empress! Air Groove-san! 
Groove-chan!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: So many fans—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At this rate, the stands are going to 
descend into utter chaos...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ――Please, settle down.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When Air Groove spoke in her clear, 
commanding voice, the fans shut their 
mouths all at once, as if perfectly 
drilled...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Now then, that person over there, and... 
also that person. And the gentleman over 
there, too. ...Yes, you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Well then, for this occasion, I shall 
borrow from the three of you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...To repay all of your cheers, this 
'Empress' shall deliver nothing less than 
victory.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove received the item from the fan 
and sprinted toward the goal line.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOOOOOOHHH--!!!)

text_block_list.name: Lots of Fans
text_block_list.text: Empress! Empress! Empress! Empress!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Amidst ringing chants of "Empress," Air 
Groove crossed the finish line of the 
scavenger hunt in a glorious 1st place—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, the Fan Appreciation Festival 
came to a safe close without any major 
issues...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"As for Air Groove, who was busy both 
running the event and competing as an 
athlete—"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...I'm glad the Thanksgiving Festival 
ended without any trouble.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You as well. You were a big help today.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...For me personally, this Thanksgiving 
Festival served as a sobering reminder to 
stay focused.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. It made me realize once again just 
how many fans are supporting me.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
For their sake, both men and women 
alike... I must continue to conduct myself 
in a manner befitting the "Empress."
choice_data_list: The Takarazuka Kinen—gotta give it my all.
The Takarazuka Kinen—gotta give it my all!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Air Groove and I toasted with 
carrot juice to celebrate the Fan 
Appreciation Festival ending without a 
hitch.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I silently prayed that the cheers of her 
many fans would lend her strength in the 
Takarazuka Kinen.
